sentence: Flagella signaling in airway cells can be initiated by interactions with asialoGM1 and TLR2 as well as by activation of TLR5.

title: Toll-like receptor 5-mediated corneal epithelial inflammatory responses to Pseudomonas aeruginosa flagellin.
sentence: TLR5 localization in human cornea was analyzed by immunohistochemistry using anti-TLR5 antibody.

title: Toll-like receptor 5-mediated corneal epithelial inflammatory responses to Pseudomonas aeruginosa flagellin.
sentence: Anti-flagellum antiserum and anti-TLR5 antibody were used for functional blocking of flagellin stimulation and TLR5 activation.

title: Toll-like receptor 5-mediated corneal epithelial inflammatory responses to Pseudomonas aeruginosa flagellin.
sentence: Presence of flagellum- or TLR5-antisera in culture medium attenuated flagellin-induced IkappaB-alpha phosphorylation and degradation as well as IL-6 and -8 production.

title: Toll-like receptor 5-mediated corneal epithelial inflammatory responses to Pseudomonas aeruginosa flagellin.
sentence: CONCLUSIONS: Flagellin of Gram-negative pathogens such as PA contributes to the inflammatory responses of corneal epithelium in a TLR5-NF-kappaB signaling pathway-dependent manner.

title: Structural study of binding of flagellin by Toll-like receptor 5.
sentence: In order to predict the binding regions within the complex formed by Toll-like receptor 5 (TLR-5) and flagellin, a complementary hydropathy between the two proteins was sought.
